title: Could I Still Do This From Scratch?
why_read: A reflective, non-technical but relevant essay on how AI coding assistants may be eroding engineers' deep problem-solving skills.
analysis: This opinion piece raises a genuine and widely discussed concern: that heavy reliance on AI code generation tools shifts developers from actively building and reasoning through problems to passively reviewing AI output, potentially atrophying deep technical skills. It cites a Microsoft CHI 2025 study linking higher trust in AI-generated content to lower critical thinking engagement, giving it at least some grounding beyond pure anecdote. It's not a technical tutorial, but the topic is relevant and worth a thoughtful skim for engineers wondering about long-term skill effects of AI tool reliance.
